Name: Long Hair Sebastian
Author: crispykalechipss
Description:
This mod is now compatible with update 1.6!

--Please make sure you are running the game with SMAPI and Content Patcher--

This mod gives Sebastian's portraits longer, tied up hair, and some ear piercings. I included the beach portraits and sprites as well. I also tweaked his shirt in the beach portraits so the stitching looks more like a real t-shirt (I know its unrelated but it always felt off to me). Winter sprites are now included!

This is my first time making any kind of game mod or pixel art, and I'm very pleased and excited with how it turned out.

As far as I am aware, it is compatible with other content patcher portrait mods (I tested It specifically with Leyalluna's Portrait mod and it worked perfectly).
I also tested it with the Portraiture mod, and I was able to switch between the large and small portrait.
This mod has not been tested with the seasonal portraits mod, and may not work correctly with it.

If you would like to disable the mod, simply remove it from your mods folder until you would like to use it again.

If you find any bugs, or have any suggestions, feel free make a post and let me know, and I will respond if I can!

If you would like to make any edits to the mod, please ask me first before redistributing
